rows.ARS:
Orange blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Lovers' Meeting
rows.Origin: Bred by Douglas L. Gandy (United Kingdom, 1980).
rows.Bloom: Orange, orange-pink outer petals. Mild fragrance. 25 to 30 petals. Average diameter 3.75". Large, very double, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: up to 30" (up to 75cm). Width: up to 30" (up to 75cm).
